user.title: Lutron Caséta Events
user.description: Creates an event entity for every Pico and keypad button your Caséta bridge knows, attached to each button's existing device. There is nothing to configure — buttons are discovered automatically. If you pair new remotes later, reload this integration to pick them up.

abort.no_lutron_caseta: Set up the Lutron Caséta integration first — this integration only re-exposes its button events.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single instance is needed — it covers every bridge.
